title: Constituency office opening hours
summary: The constituency office is open to all residents of East Ayawaso. [Sample: replace with the real days, times and address.]
body: The constituency office is open to every resident of East Ayawaso who needs help, wants to raise an issue in their community, or would like to share an idea.
Opening hours: [days and times]. Address: [office address].
You can also send a message at any time through the Contact page, and the office will respond as soon as possible.

title: Welcome to the new constituency website
summary: A new home for news, photos and direct contact with the MP's office. [Sample: for the office to approve or replace.]
body: This website gives the people of East Ayawaso one trusted place to follow the MP's work, see what is happening across the constituency, and reach the office directly.
News and announcements will be posted here regularly. Please share them with your family, friends and neighbours.

title: Town hall meeting: [community], [date]
summary: Come and share your views with the MP. [Sample: shows how an event notice will look.]
body: The MP invites residents of [community] to a town hall meeting on [date] at [time], at [venue].
Everyone is welcome. Come with your questions, concerns and ideas for the development of the constituency.
